summary.text: Emily Jordan is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia representing District 17.
The Senate biography lists Emily Jordan's service in the House of Delegates from 2018 to 2024 and in the Senate since 2024.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography says Emily Jordan was born in Wyandot County, Ohio, and raised in Suffolk, Virginia.
Emily Jordan's listed occupation is small business owner.
Emily Jordan's listed memberships and affiliations include the Windsor Ruritan Club and the Virginia Interagency Coordinating Council (as the legislator member).
The biography lists Andrew Jordan as Emily Jordan's spouse.
The Senate page lists Emily Jordan's committee assignments as General Laws and Technology, Privileges and Elections, and Rehabilitation and Social Services.
